rules.detail: Charged at the barrier before Kasol, two-wheelers included. Since May 2026 Himachal vehicles pay too; Kullu and Lahaul and Spiti vehicles stay exempt. No official page found.

rules.title: Himachal entry toll for vehicles from other states
rules.detail: Charged at entry barriers under the yearly toll policy. Notified rates name passenger and goods vehicles only. The Chief Minister said two-wheelers stay exempt. The policy document was not opened.

No road number found for the Bhuntar to Manikaran to Barshaini road.
Altitude of Barshaini, the highest point reached by road, was not found; Manikaran is used instead.
Kasol barrier fee: amounts are reported by a newspaper only, so they are left out.
The night-only rule for heavy vehicles comes from an operator guide; the district order was not found.
No official source found on which office announces road status for the Parvati valley.
